# NexMusic Desktop 0.12.2 – lyrics fixed

## Lyrics load again
- Since v0.11.0 every lyrics fetch crashed with a null-check error before any
  provider was contacted (the provider-order code removed a map entry and then
  tried to read it again). The order setting now applies correctly and lyrics
  (LRCLIB / KuGou / YouTube) load on every track.
